parameters.name: AssociateType
parameters.description:
The type of the resource with which the route table is associated. Valid values:

*   **VSwitch**
*   **Gateway**

parameters.name: EnsRegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the ENS node.

parameters.name: EnsRegionIds
parameters.description: The IDs of edge nodes. You can specify 1 to 100 IDs.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page.

parameters.name: RouteTableId
parameters.description: The ID of the route table.

parameters.name: RouteTableName
parameters.description: The name of the route table.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description:
The SNAT type.

*   FullCone: full cone NAT.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ens describe-ens-route-tables --page-number 1 --page-size 30 --route-table-id vtb-5p1cifr72di0000 --network-id n-257gqcdfvx6n0000 --ens-region-id cn-xian-unicom --ens-region-ids cn-chengdu-telecom-4 --type FullCone --associate-type Gateway --route-table-name tftest-nat04 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ens DescribeEnsRouteTables --region cn-hangzhou --EnsRegionIds.1 'cn-chengdu-telecom-4' --Type FullCone --RouteTableId 'vtb-5p1cifr72di0000' --PageSize 30 --PageNumber 1 --AssociateType Gateway --NetworkId 'n-257gqcdfvx6n0000' --EnsRegionId 'cn-xian-unicom' --RouteTableName 'tftest-nat04' --method POST --force
